title: Aranet Cross-Floor Temperature Consistency Analysis

dataSources: `index=environment` · `sourcetype="aranet:sensor"` (co2_ppm, temp_c, humidity_pct, pressure_hpa, battery_pct, rssi_dbm) Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
app: Custom HEC or scripted input from Aranet Cloud API / Aranet PRO base station — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)
spl:
index=environment sourcetype="aranet:sensor" earliest=-24h
| eval floor=coalesce(floor, level, "")
| eval temp=tonumber(coalesce(temp_c, ""))
| eval building=coalesce(building, site, "main")
| stats avg(temp) as avg_temp stdev(temp) as temp_spread by floor building
description: Identifies when Consistency Analysis criteria fire for 'Aranet Cross-Floor Temperature Consistency Analysis' (UC-14.10.14) in `index=environment` sourcetype `aranet:sensor`. Pipeline aggregates `avg_temp`, `temp_spread` by `floor`, `building` over `the scheduled window`. Alert logic enforces -24h. Title terms: Aranet, Cross, Floor, Temperature, Consistency. Eliminates manual hunting for UC-14.10.14 conditions.

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Maintenance window on `environment` (UC-14.10.14)** — Planned work for 'Aranet Cross-Floor Temperature Consistency Analysis' shifts `avg_temp`, `temp_spread` over `span=1h` while `floor`, `building` remains in-scope.  Cross-check CMDB CHG.

2. **Batch `avg` on `aranet:sensor`** — Scheduled automation elevates `building` without crossing configured threshold for UC-14.10.14. Compare `_time` minute against the job schedule.

3. **Synthetic probe on `floor`, `building`** — Health checks in `environment` populate the same fields the SPL groups on. Exclude monitoring-tagged assets before paging.

4. **Onboarding burst for `aranet:sensor`** — First 48h baseline for UC-14.10.14 on `floor` is unstable; window via `ops_exception_register.csv`.

**Suppression mechanism:** `ops_exception_register.csv` keyed on `floor`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`.
detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Custom HEC or scripted input from Aranet Cloud API / Aranet PRO base station — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=aranet:sensor into environment. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`building, floor`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
